chunks: Safwan narrated from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:

I asked Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about a ten-year-old boy performing hajj. He said: "The hajj of Islam is upon him when he reaches puberty, and likewise the girl—the hajj is upon her when she menstruates."

key_terms.احْتَلَمَ: he reached puberty through seminal emission
key_terms.حَجَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ: the obligatory hajj required in Islam after legal responsibility begins
key_terms.يَحُجُّ: performs hajj or goes on pilgrimage

ai.seo_question: When does hajj become obligatory on a boy or girl in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the obligation of hajj for children. It states that hajj becomes the obligatory Hajj of Islam only upon puberty: for a boy when he has a seminal emission, and for a girl when she begins menstruation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2898 - Safwan narrated from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan (as) about a ten-year-old boy performing Hajj.
Imam (as) said: "The Hajj of Islam becomes obligatory upon him if he reaches puberty, and likewise for a girl—it becomes obligatory upon her when she begins menstruating."
